topic: Helping a colleague review his code
passage: Last Tuesday afternoon, my teammate asked me to look through his new code. He had worked on a small tool that printed student reports. I sat down at my desk and opened the project on my laptop. First, I looked over the main file and noticed a few spelling mistakes. Then I pointed out a method that mixed two different tasks. He nodded and asked me to walk him through a better design. We talked for twenty minutes and wrote down three simple steps. After that, he cleaned up the messy names and pulled out the extra lines. I checked the tests and found that two cases had failed. He fixed the first one quickly, but the second one turned out to be harder. We went back to the log and figured out that an empty value had slipped in. He added a check and ran the tests again. This time every test passed. I praised his patience and added a short comment on the request. Before we wrapped up, he thanked me and promised to go over the notes after dinner. The review took almost one hour, but the tool looked much clearer in the end.

coach_rationale: 今早直查了 drill_sessions：有分听写仍是 7 次，最近一次仍是 10-22，样本未增加。EnglishPod365 仍无带 error_types 的新记录；Mac 上的 EnglishPod365 笔记最新仍停在 10 月中旬的 EP0012，弱项还是短语动词连读和过去式听辨，所以今天继续把这两类靶子埋进短文。这篇「帮同事做代码评审」是全新的工作科技话题，短文里有 asked/worked/printed/opened/looked/noticed/pointed/nodded/talked/cleaned/pulled/checked/failed/fixed/turned/figured/slipped/added/passed/praised/wrapped/thanked/promised 等规则过去式；look through、sat down、looked over、pointed out、walk him through、wrote down、cleaned up、pulled out、turned out、went back、figured out、slipped in、wrapped up、go over 是今天的短语动词连读靶子。难度保持听写 B1、跟读 A2。
